reviews.text:
This is an interesting place, and the online booking system makes it easy to schedule, cancel, or reschedule an appointment. The problem is that the available time slots in the portal do not always match the location’s actual schedule. As a result, appointments may be double-booked or need to be rescheduled, and sometimes you are not told until you arrive.

Their explanation was that they tried to call me, but that is not sufficient notice when someone has arranged their entire schedule around the appointment. For those of us who work Monday through Friday, finding time for an appointment is already challenging. The booking system is convenient, but it is only helpful if the availability shown online is accurate and scheduling changes are communicated clearly and in advance.
Hi Sitara - We appreciate you sharing your positive experience with the Banfield team. 🧡 We’re grateful to be a part of your pet's care team. …

Hi Lou, thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We strive to provide every client with a positive experience in our hospitals. Your feedback will be passed along to our hospital staff and please do not hesitate to email us at BanfieldCares@banfield.com if you have any additional concerns.

honestly this place just makes me sad. every time i schedule an appointment for my 14 year old deaf cavalier, they call the same day and cancel my appt.
for example i made an appt for today at 8 am. they called me to re re schedule for 10:30. then called me when it got close to 10:30 to cancel my appt.

this has happened so many times. and they blame it on the “ new scheduling system”

instead of banfield taking care of this issue during after hours so this doesnt continue to happen, this is ignored and they just keep cancelling appointments.

what is the point of having insurance with then when they cannot honor anytimes for patients.

i recommend you DO NOT get their wellness plan and go to another hospital for your pet.
Awesome  staff and thank u dr Q

Let’s just say the worst !! Can’t ever get an appointment . I
Made and appointment two days ago for today and they called me this morning to tell me that they do not have appointments available in the morning ever . So now my dog has to suffer through her allergies another day because these
Ppl decided to call me last minute .  Apparently they open at 8 am but only have appointments available until after 1 pm! Make it make sense ?  I rather take my dog elsewhere . There’s no way I’m just going to drop of my dog and leave her with random ppl. I don’t recommend wasting your time.

I took my cat Marsh here for the first time today and it was great! Everyone was super friendly, informative, and patient. They were open and upfront about pricing and accommodating to my pets needs with what works for me financially in mind. I’m super picky about who I take my animals to for care but these guys gave a great first impression and are awesome. I will definitely be bringing Marsh back. I highly recommend checking this place out as a vet office🫶🐛
I had dinner last night with a group of people and the hostesses were raving about their vet, Dr. Q.  Don't we all!
Awesome bet and vet tech. Great experience and my dog is already feeling better. Thank you!
Thanks for trusting us with your BFF 🧡 We appreciate the review! …
Amazing staff, so friendly and helpful. I’ve used their health plans for all of my family pets and I’ve never been disappointed - such a great team!

TL/DR: Go to a different location.

By far, this was the worst experience I have had with a Banfield location.

I brought in both of my dogs and was very clear with the staff that I wanted them updated on any vaccines they were due for. At the initial appointment on Monday, I was advised that one of my dogs should receive a dental cleaning. Since the procedure was included in my wellness plan, I agreed and scheduled the cleaning for Wednesday. Before leaving, I specifically confirmed with the veterinary technician that the vaccines had been administered that day, and I was told they had.

On the morning of the dental cleaning, I checked my dog's Banfield profile and noticed it showed that no vaccines had been given. When I arrived for the dental appointment, I brought this discrepancy to the staff's attention. The technician informed me that the vaccines would be administered that day instead.

After the dental procedure, the Banfield app was updated to show that the vaccines had actually been given on Monday. This immediately raised concerns. When I picked up my dog, I asked for clarification because the information I had been given was inconsistent. The technician then told me that my dog had received the vaccines again that morning, despite the records now showing they had already been administered on Monday.

Rather than acknowledging the error, I was told that the second administration could simply serve as the "booster" dose and that my dog would not need to return in two weeks. This explanation did little to address my concerns about how such a serious discrepancy occurred in the first place.

The entire experience was incredibly disorganized and reflected a concerning lack of communication and record accuracy. As a pet owner, I expect clear, accurate medical records and confidence that my pets are receiving appropriate care. Unfortunately, this experience left me questioning both.
It's always a warm welcome when i come to this Banfield. The staff is amazing and super friendly 😁❤️ I have two small Chihuahuas and their handled very careful and with affection!!

I hate writing this review because the male veterinarian who saw my dog was kind and caring. Unfortunately, the rest of my experience at Banfield Hillcrest was extremely horrible.

No one seemed to have a clear idea of what was going on, and the entire process felt disorganized and poorly managed.

The nurses and support staff were not communicative, and I spent over an hour waiting with very little explanation. I had to check in over three times and no one seem to know what was going on. They were also not busy. The manager did not do anything to improve the situation or provide meaningful updates while I sat there waiting. She was lost and had no idea what I was talking about. So I do not trust my dog here.

I took my cat to Banfield Pet Hospital because she had blood in her stool. I brought in a fecal sample and was told results would take 24–72 hours. A week went by with no call. I called them, and they still didn’t have the results. Another week passed, and I called again, and they still didn’t have the results. THREE WEEKS went by with no call or update, so I called them AGAIN and that’s when they admitted the lab had lost the sample/results.

So I brought in a second fecal sample. Then the exact same thing happened again weeks of silence. AGAIN On the THIRD week, I finally called them myself, only to be told, “Oh yeah, the results came back and there were no parasites.” Nobody called me. Nobody texted me. Nobody followed up. This took almost TWO MONTHS just to get a basic answer, and the only reason I even got one was because I kept chasing them down myself. Then after all of that, they told me I needed to pay for another exam if I wanted anyone to actually look at my cat. Absolutely ridiculous.

If you care about timely communication or competent follow-up for your pet, avoid this place. Losing test results once is bad enough. Never contacting the owner is unacceptable. They completely lost my trust and my business.

I’ve been a Banfield customer for 7 years, and my dog was always treated at the Pacific Beach location, where I never had any issues. However, after moving and starting to use the Hillcrest location for the past almost 2 years, my experience has been extremely disappointing.

This specific location constantly seems to have problems, ranging from canceled appointments to incorrect charges. Recently, I requested a change to my dog’s wellness plan, and I was told everything had been updated correctly. Despite that, I continued being charged the old amount.

I also had a very concerning experience after my dog’s dental cleaning. He developed an infection that lasted for over a week, and when I tried to bring him back to be checked, I was told they couldn’t see him.

After multiple frustrating experiences, I’ve decided I will not return to this location. I would rather drive to the Pacific Beach unit, where the staff has always been professional, organized, and caring. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend the Hillcrest location based on my experience.
The staff was great the veterinarian was a godsend for are little diva doggy  Mama's I praise the staff I salute the staff anything else would be oun  civilized
Hi Patrick - Thank you "fur" the review! 🐕 …
The issues with my dog were explained in detail / all went quite well with this visit ..

My most recent visit marked my final visit to Banfield. I have to give at least 1 star for being available for a check up on a Sunday morning.

My dogs are not new to Banfield, and I am well aware of their Wellness protection program. I did not balk at the ~$900 for vaccinations, check up, 6 months of Simparica Trio for my two dogs, and a pedicure. We agreed with the front desk and there was no fuss on the pricing.

2 and half hours later, I get a call that one dog is too anxious for nail trim and questioned on her wellbeing at home. Had they noted these on her file from previous visits, it would not be new to them that she is a rescue. This goes back to you no longer having face to face with the vet. I pay you $250/dog, the least the provider can do is chart the dogs health both physically and mentally or allow me to be with my dogs so they can be at ease.

Further to that, they didn't even do the vaccinations and instead tried to sell me on the wellness plan. Listen, this isn't my first Banfield visit nor is it my first pitch on the wellness plan. We didn't even fuss on the estimated cost earlier. Do the vaccinations and then pitch the wellness plan when we pick up the dogs. "Oh but we can do the vaccinations real quick" no you lost me at this point. You spent two and half hours to cursory glance at my dog, tried unsuccessfully to trim their nails (somehow the techs at Petco have no problem), didn't perform the vaccinations, and never ONCE met you face to face Dr. Quiroz.

I love Banfield Hillcrest!!

Scheduling is always incredibly easy and convenient, which makes such a difference with a busy schedule. From the front desk team to the clinical/vet staff, everyone is consistently kind, professional, and welcoming.

As a new puppy parent, it’s so easy to overthink and question every little thing, but they’ve been nothing but supportive and reassuring. I’m grateful to have found a team I trust completely with his care. Highly recommend!

The staff was courteous, gentle and professional.  Some were from the closed facility Marina District, remembering my excitable tribe, Mama Bonnie, Papa Clyde & Son Junior Cuddle Bug.
My appointment was a drop-off at 09:00 for my 3 large Pitbulls,
all 3 -comprehensive exams, vaccines, nails clipped, 2-dental cleaning, 1-ears cleaned). I wanted to make sure that his ears weren't infected or worse, which needed to be looked inside with an otoscope.
The veterinarian on duty, Dr. Katie Turner called me a couple of hours later to let me know that their liver enzyme levels were a tad high, but not a significant difference since their last cleaning.
We discussed their procedures, treatments, etc.  She also listened to my concerns along with questions about their kibble being over processed, & if she thought they should have an alternative, which is much too costly. She suggested for me to try an OTC Royal Canin Senior kibble to see if that would halt their food allergies as well as lowering their liver enzyme levels at their next visit in 6 months.
I also let her know bcz this visit had an added expense, that I would be sharing their bi-monthly Heart Worm Rx as well as their monthly parasite drops. We talked for over 17 minutes.
All 3 of my Pitties have wellness plans (which I highly recommend).
I spend $209 monthly for the three.  And at this visit, I had extra services that weren't covered in their plans, i.e. clipped toenails on all 12 paws, added parasite drops & ear cleaning. My fee only came to $188, but their covered services were over $3700.
I am a senior and had previously fell in mid summer, and have either a bad dislocated or broken wrist on my dominant hand. That's why I had their nails professionally done. They were so long they were like TALONS!  I can now trim my own fingernails.  I can patch the holes in my couches and don't have to worry getting scratches on my legs & arms. The dog grooming locations are much cheaper, but they use a grinder instead, which causes much faster growth.
Later in the afternoon, another staff member called me for over 8 minutes to let me know my fur babies were in recovery, needing observation for another of couple of hours bcz the dental cleaning used General Anesthesia. Afterwards they had their comprehensive exams and vaccinations. After 16:00, they were ready for pick up and was very excited to get back home.
Banfield Pet Hospital in Hillcrest.

TLDR: they charge $90 for a 9 minute appointment and don’t even double check if your pet’s vaccines are expiring soon. They do the bare minimum and nothing else so they can justify more visits in less time to sell you their subscription. Go somewhere else or accept you’ll be paying a lot.

When the Banfield downtown closed I was more than happy to come to this place because of how attentive the previous location was for my dog. My dog had a vet appointment 8 months ago, but I took him in 2 months ago because they said the new doctor has to see him to refill his prescription. Sure, the vet appointment was 6 months early, but better safe than sorry, so I took him and they saw him for a whole 9 minutes (I counted from the time I left the car to when I came back in) and I guess the $120 they charged me was worth it to refill his prescription.

They did not, however, check in those 9 minutes if he was overdue for any of his vaccines, which is apparently not included in an “establishing care” visit. Or at least they didn’t notice that one expired exactly that week that I was at the vet. Forgive me, I thought since they check human vaccines at a human establishing care visit, it would be the same at a vet. I guess not at Banfield! So when I took him back yesterday to get his one vaccine he needed, and they tried to charge a $90 office visit fee for the 3rd time in less than a year. I cancelled the appointment on the spot and left. I recommend basically any other vet, the Vecto down the street took care of him just fine.

Sorry to the veterinarian who works here who is really nice. I just can’t be paying $10/minute for someone to look at my dog and not even tell me if a vaccine expired that week.
Thanks for trusting us with your BFF 🧡 We appreciate the review! …

I like this hospital and its staff. In my opinion $92 a month for the plan is absolutely worth it. They always make sure my dog and I feel good about everything. They always explain everything I ask them. Having a 24/7 chat is giving me peace of mind. Had a few situations when they really helped me.

My pup and I have had no problems or uncomfortable visits at the Point Loma location. However, the 3 times that we’ve gone to the Hillcrest location it is a very off putting experience. There is a lack of transparency when it comes to medical information, treatment necessity, and pricing—unless asking in detail, but without a medical background how detailed can I really get? From the receptionists to the doctors at this location I feel like I’m met with apathy and coldness.

Banfield Pet Hospital - Hillcrest
Dr. Alfredo Miller Quiroz

I am extremely disappointed with my continued experience at the Hillcrest Banfield location, particularly surrounding my dog's neuter surgery And wellness plans.

My dog is currently 14 months old. I purchased the Banfield wellness plan specifically because it includes neutering. When my puppy was just over 6 months old, I asked to schedule the procedure and was told I needed to decide exactly at 6 months -- something that was never explained at any appointment or visit. I was then advised by staff to wait until my dog was a year old. I followed their recommendation.

When the time came, I renewed a more expensive (2nd) wellness plan, scheduled the surgery, and repeatedly called to confirm that:

* The procedure and what was needed was included in the plan
* I would be charged correctly

I was reassured multiple times by multiple staff members that everything was covered.

On the day of surgery, they attempted to cancel my dog's appointment for the second time, while I was already in the parking lot waiting for them to open. I refused the cancellation. I was told they were "squeezing my dog in," which in hindsight should have been another red flag.

After drop-off, I received a call from Dr. Alfredo Miller Quiroz, who stated he was unsure how to proceed and that I would need to pay additional costs because the recommended procedure was not covered -- directly contradicting everything I had confirmed beforehand. Several times due to the previous experience.

When I explained the repeated miscommunication and incorrect information I had been given, the conversation shifted, and it felt as though my concerns were taken as a personal insult rather than a valid issue. I was not insulting anyone -- I was pointing out that I had been misled and poorly handled throughout this process.

Additionally, phone wait times are extremely long, and in-person visits routinely involve excessive waiting, even when arriving on time for scheduled appointments. This only compounds the frustration and reflects deeper operational issues at this location.

Unfortunately, after reading other reviews, I now agree with many of the poor comments about how this location is run. What is especially disappointing is that the veterinarians appear to go along with these practices rather than stepping in to help resolve or improve the situation.

This experience with other simular interactions showed a lack of clear communication, accountability, and professionalism. I trusted Banfield with my pet and followed their guidance at every step, only to be put in a stressful situation, wrongful recommendations all on the day of surgery.

WARNING: If you are enrolling in a Banfield wellness plan, do not rely on any assistance or confirmations. Be prepared for long waits, last-minute changes, or unexpected charges -- even when procedures are supposedly included in your plan And arrangements were made.

I cannot recommend this location.

Please do not take your pet/loved one here.  I went to bring my pet there with it being an in person appointment at 11am.  When i arrived they said they would be 3-4 hours before they get to my pet and would let me know how the appointment went.

No where was it mentioned that it wouldn't be an in person appointment.  The nice medical assistant said we could reschedule for 4:30PM.  So me and my dog went home and waited.

We arrived at 4:20pm for our appointment and a different medical assistant said we missed our appointment.

This place is a joke and dont bring your pet/loved one here.  Spent the whole day coming back and forth and the only option was to reschedule.

I'm sorry to share this, but the receptionists have poor service. I called last week to schedule a dental appointment and they gave it to me today, the 23rd. I found it strange that they didn't call me to confirm. I tried to call, but it always went to voicemail or they didn't answer. So I decided to show up today for my appointment, and it wasn't scheduled - not for today or another day! What are the receptionists doing? They're not doing their job right. They don't answer calls and they don't schedule appointments right. Banfiel is having poor service every
Great staff and doctors! I was sent here after the Marina office closed and I couldn't be happier! Punky & Colt love their visits!
Too expensive for what you get.  Spent hrs trying to get thr on phone today.
This place almost killed my dog a year ago. There are so many better vets to go too in SD.

THIS IS FOR THE HILLCREST LOCATION: Please choose another place for your pet to be looked after. They have over worked staff and nobody checks you in for 30+ minutes. I had one appointment here for my puppy’s first exam, and I gave them a stool sample. They told me it would be 3 business days until someone called me on a Friday. I called them on a Wednesday and was told must be nothing since we didn’t call you. After realizing my puppy had worms, I called back to ask if they could double check 2 weeks later. They said oh the vet needs to speak with you and they set up an appointment and charged me to tell me my dog actually had Giardia ( which he has already been treated for before he was adopted.) They took my money and promised a supervisor would call me back, and weeks later still nothing.
It’s nice to go into a place where you’re known and created with care and concern about your pet. Fantastic doctors that communicate well and listen to your concerns.
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾 …
40 Minutes to check in. Then they confused my dog with another and gave my dog a pedicure and charged me for it, but failed to do his blood work that I brought him in for.

My dog had an appointment on 8/21 they were running behind and I never even saw anyone at the front desk upon arrival for 20 minutes. I was moves back and forth from lobby to exam room multiple times two and a half hours. The Dr gave my dogs partial and assumed diagnosis in the lobby which was possible kidney disease. I had do bring a urine sample the next morning and never heard back about his definite diagnosis or health care plan from anyone, it is now the 27th so a week later. I had to call multiple times to only get prescriptions for food, but was not given any further information. The times I called the staff was unhelpful, rude and unprofessional. I was told the manager would call me and they never did. I have consistently had issues at this location and will never return. The level of care provided is completely unacceptable and their customer service is deplorable. Don’t take your pets there.
I love every one there
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾 …

Despite having an appointment, our cat was left alone in the back room and wasn't seen for almost 2 hours; it then took another 30 minutes or more to check out. I understand that things get busy sometimes, but other reviewers have had similar issues—and this seems very slow given that we had an appointment.

Further, the price was pretty unreasonable. I don't think we'll be taking him back here—we've had much better service at other clinics in San Diego.

The front desk is friendly and helpful, however the hospital as a while is bit too busy/hectic. I dropped off my cat for an 11am appointment and was told it would take 2-3 hours for a regular check up, it took 5 hours. Turns out the doctor was tending to an emergency, which I understand happens but the lack of communication wasn't ideal. I also submitted a fecal sample for testing and the front desk noted to give me a call whether the results were positive or negative. No one gave me a call. I called 3 days after and was told everything was negative. Whenever I call the office I'm never answered on the first time, I get an automated message try again and answered on the second+ time. While I understand there are busy times, the lack of communication has rubbed me the wrong way.
Great food and great bartender! Lots of great concersation. Patrons very friendly

Banfield just wants your money! Poor pet care. Dr U did not even read her own report and the hospital did not remember anything. We basically paid $252 for nothing. And were asked to make an appointment again and pay the fees again.

Also, i sent an email on the one they provided. Its been 6 days and no response!

I love this Banfield, you can actually speak to a person when you call, reception is always friendly and helpful.
The staff is kind, never salesy and they give me updates on my pets behavior for drop off appointments. They’re open on Saturday’s which is a huge plus and overall I’ve had great experiences each time I’ve brought in my cat.

Took my dog here for one visit before he pooped out what looked like a tumor!
Trued to drop off the tumor asap but had to wait 3 days until they had an appointment for him. Doc did a finger-up-the-butt exam, and didnt feel anything, then sent the sample to be tested for parasites, NOT tissue/cancer as I had asked.

Got no call regarding his results until I inquired a week later, and thats when I found out they dont even offer cancer screening and that I should have taken him to a specialist. All doctors I asked/talked to just said "ive never seen anything like that before."

They refunded me the cost of the exam and test ($290), but now all we can do is wait for another mass to come out of him, symptoms to begin, or a $600 colonoscopy!

Will not be brining my dog back to this vet, and will be supporting the few local/small business vets in the area that are not too locked in on corporate protocol to refer me to a specialist when something is out of their scope.

The vet couldn’t check my cat for eye ulcers because….my cat didn’t let him. Then was prescribed with antibiotic ointment which they charged me $54, 2 months later he was getting better but the medicine ran out, the tube is only 3.5g, order a refill from chewy for $10.49. Banfield deny it. I had to go back to the office to convince them to approve the prescription. They say yes (for a one time only) otherwise I’ll have to bring my cat back. I ordered the refill yesterday, we’ll see if they approve it. The fact that a consult that’s less than 15 min, when i still spend more than an hour to get done, is charged over 60 dollars and a medicine that a company who makes profit charges that much less for is, in my humble opinion, nothing less than a robbery.
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾 …
Thanks for the paw-sitive review!

We’ve been coming to Banfield for many years (close to 20 years). We have three dogs. We have the wellness plan with Banfield because it is affordable. We have always had friendly service.

Today we came in for a cytopoint shot for our dog who had an itchy foot. We got to the location 5 minutes before our appointment and were not seen until 30 minutes after we were scheduled. We were told that the doctor got behind. We understand the previous visits could have gone long. However, taking this long to see a vet tech is always taken 30 minutes to be seen.

We were assigned to a room and when we got in there, the table had not been cleaned from the prior client.  The table was covered in dog hair and prints from the previous dog.

when the vet tech came in, she informed us that we were also getting a 6 month comprehensive examination part of our wellness program. We had not been informed about this when we were checked in as we had only scheduled for a cytopoint shot with the vet tech.

So now what should’ve been a 15 minute appointment for just a shot with the Vet tech has turned into a full physical with the vet, in addition to the shot. We have now been here well over an hour. One of the big problems with Banfield is checkout. It can take 10 to 15 minutes just to check out.

We are considering going to another vet because of the time that it takes for each visit. On another note, our dogs had their annual wellness visit six months ago and they told us today that this is a six month check. If that’s the case, why haven’t we received any notification for our other two dogs for a 6 month wellness check?
This place is professional as they come… Thank you 🙏 for all that you do Banfield ! …
The vets here are excellent and staff is friendly

We have been bringing our Chiweenie to this Hillcrest location for years, and keep coming back because of the exceptional care we receive. Every single employee treats both my dog and me with the utmost respect. This is an honest vet who genuinely cares about your pet and does NOT nickel and dime you.

When our primary vet left the practice, we started seeing Dr. Q, and I couldn’t be happier. He is compassionate, kind, and incredibly knowledgeable. Dr. Q takes the time to make sure you feel heard and answers all of your questions thoroughly.

My dog has MAJOR anxiety and this entire office is more than accommodating to ensure my pup is as relaxed as possible.

I highly recommend this location for anyone looking for trustworthy and caring veterinary care!

P.S - LOOK INTO THE BANFIELD WELLNESS PLANS!! 100% worth every single penny.

We love the Banfield Hillcrest team! :)

Pros: wellness plans that include dental cleanings for my cats and comprehensive visits (for blood work, stool samples, weight, & vaccines). Staff are friendly & communicative. Vets are willing to answer concerns and questions. Scheduling is easy.

Con: my only minor con is that the VCA allowed me to be in the room during the vet visit. The staff here let me know I could request that in the future. I think my girls get stressed when they don’t see me.
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾 …
Wonderful experience booking a last minute urgent appointment for a health certificate to travel. The staff was polite and the experience was smooth and easy.
Thanks for the pawsitive review!

Just go to a mom and pop vet and not here. Been going to Banfield for 2+ years (simply because it’s close to our house), but it has proven to be a disappointment time and time again. Communication about your animal’s health is sub par, and …

affordable and above and beyond treatment! my dog is incredibly skittish, every time i get her from a vet or groomer she bolts straight to the door, ready to leave. This time? Wagging tail and affectionate towards the vets, she had the best experience possible. thanks guys :)
they are great here. my cat is diabetic and needs regular visits, they are aware of his specific needs upon visits and make us feel valued.
